criteria.requirement: Use existing bytes/write_bytes or binary chunks with a binary writer to preserve every byte, including NUL/FF and mixed newlines. Use chunked reads when whole-file memory is unsuitable. Do not decode arbitrary bytes as text or claim text conversion automatically preserves all bytes.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
